title: Grappler Baki Maximum Tournament
native: グラップラー刃牙(バキ) 最大トーナメント編
synopsis:
Baki, a great grappler needs to live up to his name being the son of the greatest grapplers of all time: Hanma Yujiro. At the Shinshinkai Organization's private arena, anything goes and the odds are always stacked against you. Current champion of the urderground tournament he fight to defend his title against the worlds strongest and best martial artists, including "the beast" his own father Yujiro.

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: Super A-Class Reserve
episodes.synopsis: In the third A-Block match of round one, heavyweight kickboxing champion Rob Robinson takes on the professional wrestler Anton Igari; in the fourth A-Block match of round one, Motobe Izo fights the grand sumo Kinryuzan; in the first B-Block match of round one, the Sambo master Sergei Taktaroff fights Retsu Kaio, a master of Chinese Kenpo; in the second B-Block match of round one, Kato fights the son of the Yasha Ape.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Goal
episodes.synopsis: Baki saves the Yasha Ape's son from Katsumi; in the third B-Block match of round one, Hanayama fights the Japanese Kenpo master Inagi Bunnoshin; in the fourth B-Block match of round one, Roland Gustaf, a catch-as-catch-can wrestler, fights Orochi Katsumi.

episodes.title: Here Comes the King
episodes.synopsis: Yujiro arrives and enters his protégé Amanai Yu in the tournament; in the first C-Block match of round one, heavyweight boxing world champion Ian McGregor fights Taekwondo master Li Moko; in the second C-Block match of round one, biker gang leader Shiba Chiharu fights judo master Hatanaka Kohei; in the third C-Block match of round one, Shorinji Kenpo master Misaki Kengo fights pro wrestler Mike Queen.

episodes.title: The Right to Fight Him
episodes.synopsis: Brazilian Jiu-jitsu master Sergio Silva faces pit-fighter Jack Hammer in the fourth C-Block match of round one; Yujiro tries to fight Hammer, but Baki intervenes; shoot wrestler Yamamoto Minoru faces Amanai Yu in the first D-Block match of round one.

episodes.title: Master
episodes.synopsis: Richard Filth, a bouncer, faces Orochi Doppo in the second D-Block match of round one; Roger Harlon, an amateur wrestler, faces the jujutsu master Shibukawa Goki in the third D-Block match of round one; Shinogi Kureha faces Shinogi Kousho in the fourth D-Block match of round one.

episodes.title: The Surpasser
episodes.synopsis: The fourth D-Block match of round one continues as Shinogi Kureha and Shinogi Kousho continue to fight; Baki faces Zulu in the first A-Block match of round two.

episodes.title: The Reason Why He Can`t Lose
episodes.synopsis: In the second A-Block match of round two, Igari faces Kinryuzan; in the first B-Block match of round two, Retsu Kaio faces Mount Toba.

episodes.title: The Warrior VS. The Chivalrous
episodes.synopsis: In the second B-Block match of round two, Hanayama faces Orochi Katsumi.

episodes.title: The Fighter
episodes.synopsis: In the first C-Block match of round two, Shiba Chiharu faces Ian McGregor.

episodes.title: Fang
episodes.synopsis: Andreanof Garland, the last reserver, is introduced when it is deemed that Shiba is in no condition to fight in the next round; in the second C-Block match of round two, Jack Hammer faces Misaki Kengo.

episodes.title: Extreme! Orochi Ryu
episodes.synopsis: In the first D-Block match of round two, Doppo faces Amanai Yu; Baki takes Kozue to the site of his mother's death.

episodes.title: All Out!
episodes.synopsis: Yujiro fights against all of the tournament losers; in the second D-Block match of round two, Shibukawa Goki faces Shinogi Kousho.

episodes.title: Pro Wrestling Show
episodes.synopsis: Igari begs Baki to let him win, and they fight in the first match of the quarter-finals.

episodes.title: Fate! Sonic Fists
episodes.synopsis: In the second fight of the quarter-finals, Katsumi faces Retsu Kaio; Andreanof Garland fights an anaconda to make things fair, since he hasn't fought in the tournament yet, and then he faces Jack Hammer in the third fight of the quarter-finals.

episodes.title: Men Who Threw Away Their Future
episodes.synopsis: Andreanof Garland and Jack Hammer continue to fight in the third match of the quarter-finals. Also, Hammer's training history is revealed.

episodes.title: Doppo, Being active!
episodes.synopsis: Shibukawa Goki faces Doppo in the fourth match of the quarter-finals.

episodes.title: The Successor
episodes.synopsis: Baki fights Retsu Kaio in the first match of the semi-finals.

episodes.title: Tatsujin VS. Monster
episodes.synopsis: In the second match of the semi-finals, Shibukawa Goki faces Jack Hammer.

episodes.title: Fight for Victory
episodes.synopsis: Baki and Jack Hammer think about the training and hardships they've endured to reach their current level of ability.

episodes.title: Secret War in Vietnam
episodes.synopsis: Baki faces Jack Hammer in the final match of the tournament. Also, in flashback Yujiro meets Jack's mother in Vietnam.

episodes.title: The Evolved Genius
episodes.synopsis: Baki and Jack Hammer continue to fight in the final match. In flashback to Vietnam, Yujiro breaks into an American base and terrorizes the soldiers; later, Jack is born.

episodes.title: Resolutions
episodes.synopsis: Baki and Jack Hammer continue to fight in the finals as Jack's body breaks down.

episodes.title: Rencounter
episodes.synopsis: In flashback, the United States government sends its special forces to South America to kill a young Yujiro.
